_doc: lab/lite_modal.py --step compare: lab/cases.json cases run again with only some of their files swapped for the lite copies, on every seed, to see which copy changes the result. Per case, variant name → the full files it swaps: [] none (the full version), "*" all of them (the lite version), or the base names of some. One GPU, no memory cap: this looks at the outputs, not at memory. The first lab run (2026-11-23, seed 42) gave relight-neon a much weaker neon light with halos at the edges in its lite version, which swaps two files, and ref-song a different song.
